def f(I):
    Hh,Ww=len(I),len(I[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    bg=max(Counter(x for r in I for x in r).items(), key=lambda kv:kv[1])[0]
    col=I[0][0] if bg!=I[0][0] else None
    # background = most common
    seen=[[False]*Ww for _ in range(Hh)]
    stack=[(r,c) for r in range(Hh) for c in range(Ww) if I[r][c]!=bg]
    import collections
    q=collections.deque()
    for r,c in [(r,c) for r in range(Hh) for c in range(Ww)]:
        if I[r][c]!=bg and not seen[r][c]:
            q.append((r,c)); seen[r][c]=True
    while q:
        r,c=q.popleft()
        for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            a,b=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=a<Hh and 0<=b<Ww and I[a][b]==bg and not seen[a][b]:
                seen[a][b]=True; q.append((a,b))
    for r in range(Hh):
        for c in range(Ww):
            if I[r][c]==bg and not seen[r][c]:
                out[r][c]=2
    return out

from collections import Counter
def f(I):
    Hh,Ww=len(I),len(I[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    fg=[v for v in set(x for r in I for x in r) if v!=bg]
    assert len(fg)==1, fg
    mk=fg[0]
    rs=[r for r in range(Hh) for c in range(Ww) if I[r][c]==mk]
    cs=[c for r in range(Hh) for c in range(Ww) if I[r][c]==mk]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            if I[r][c]!=bg: continue
            on_edge=(r==r0 or r==r1 or c==c0 or c==c1)
            if on_edge:
                filled=False
                if r==r0:
                    L=[cc for cc in range(c0,c) if I[r][cc]==mk]; R=[cc for cc in range(c,c1+1) if I[r][cc]==mk]
                    if L and R: filled=True
                elif r==r1:
                    L=[cc for cc in range(c0,c) if I[r][cc]==mk]; R=[cc for cc in range(c+1,c1+1) if I[r][cc]==mk]
                    if L and R: filled=True
                if c==c0:
                    U=[rr for rr in range(r0,r) if I[rr][c]==mk]; D=[rr for rr in range(r,r1+1) if I[rr][c]==mk]
                    if U and D: filled=True
                elif c==c1:
                    U=[rr for rr in range(r0,r) if I[rr][c]==mk]; D=[rr for rr in range(r+1,r1+1) if I[rr][c]==mk]
                    if U and D: filled=True
                if filled: out[r][c]=2
    return out

print(f(G['Test input']))

from collections import Counter
def f(I):
    Hh,Ww=len(I),len(I[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(Hh) for c in range(Ww) if I[r][c]!=bg]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
    c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    mk=I[r0][c0]  # outline color (e.g. 1 in demo)
    # border cells of the bounding box, background, with a marker on opposite side (any along perpendicular axis)
    for c in range(c0,c1+1):
        for r in (r0,r1):
            if I[r][c]==bg:
                inside_v = any(r2==mk for r2 in range(r0+1,r1) if I[r2][c]==mk)
                left_v = any(r2<r for r2 in range(r0) if I[r2][c]==mk)
                right_v = any(r2>r for r2 in range(r1+1,Hh) if I[r2][c]==mk)
                if (left_v or right_v) and inside_v: out[r][c]=2
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):

    return out

G=load()
def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    O=[row[:] for row in I]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=bg]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
    c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    def fill(line,start,end):
        if start>=end: return
        step = 1 if line=='h' else -1
        for k in range(start+step,end,step):
            v=I[line][k] if line=='h' else I[k][line]
            if v!=bg: continue
            # walk until hitting non-bg
            lo=k; hi=k+step
            while 0<=hi<H and 0<=hi<W:
                hh,hw=line,k+step
                if I[hh][hw]==bg: break
                hi+=step
                if not (0<=hi<H and 0<=hi<W): break
            if 0<=hi<H and 0<=hi<W and I[hi][hw]!=bg and I[lo][k]==I[hi][hw]:
                for j in range(lo+step,hi,step): O[j][k]=2
    for r in (r0,r1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            if I[r][c]!=bg: continue
            left=None;right=None
            cc=c
            while cc>c0 and I[r][cc-1]==bg: cc-=1
            while cc<c1 and I[r][cc+1]==bg: cc+=1
            if cc==c and I[r][cc-1]==I[r][cc+1] and I[r][cc-1]!=bg: O[r][c]=2
    for c in (c0,c1):
        for r in range(r0,r1+1):
            if I[r][c]!=bg: continue
            up=None;down=None
            rr=r
            while rr>r0 and I[rr-1][c]==bg: rr-=1
            while rr<r1 and I[rr+1][c]==bg: rr+=1
            if rr==r and I[rr-1][c]==I[rr+1][c] and I[rr-1][c]!=bg: O[r][c]=2

G=load()
def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=bg]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
    c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    O=[row[:] for row in I]
    for r in (r0,r1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            if O[r][c]==bg: O[r][c]=2
    for c in (c0,c1):
        for r in range(r0,r1+1):
            if O[r][c]==bg: O[r][c]=2
    return O
print(all(f(G[f'Demo pair {i} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {i} output'] for i in [1,2,3]))
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# hypothesis: fill along each perimeter edge between consecutive markers; then extend from extreme marker to bbox corner only if that gap>=3 (single-marker trailing runs do NOT extend)
def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=bg]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
    c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    O=[row[:] for row in I]
    def fill(cells, line):
        marks=[j for j,v in enumerate(cells) if v!=bg]
        n=len(marks)
        if n==0: return
        for k in range(n-1):
            for j in range(marks[k]+1,marks[k+1]): O[line][j]=2
        # trailing extension from last marker toward the bbox end (right/down side) if gap>=3
        m=marks[-1]; end=c1 if len(line)<=W else r1
        if end-m>=3:
            for j in range(m+1,end+1): O[line][j]=2
        m=marks[0]; start=c0 if len(line)<=W else r0
        if m-start>=3:
            for j in range(start,m): O[line][j]=2
    for line in (r0,r1):
        cells=[I[line][j] for j in range(c0,c1+1)]; fill(cells,line)
    for line in (c0,c1):
        cells=[I[j][line] for j in range(r0,r1+1)]; fill(cells,line)
print(all(f(G[f'Demo pair {i} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {i} output'] for i in [1,2,3,4,5]))

import os,re
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k in G: continue
    if all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
print(sorted(G))
for i in (2,3,4):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; D=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(len(I)) for c in range(len(I[0])) if I[r][c]!=bg]
    print(i,'bbox',min(p[0] for p in pts),max(p[0] for p in pts),min(p[1] for p in pts),max(p[1] for p in pts),'bg',bg)

from collections import Counter
def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=bg]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
    c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    O=[row[:] for row in I]
    def line_fill(cells, cells2=None):
        if len(cells)<2: return
        a,b=cells[0],cells[-1]
        lo=[j for j,v in enumerate(cells) if v!=bg and v==I[a]] if False else [j for j,v in enumerate(cells) if v!=bg]
        # consecutive marker positions
        idx=[j for j in range(len(cells)) if I[cells[j]]!=bg]
        for k in range(len(idx)-1):
            i1,i2=idx[k],idx[k+1]
            lo,hi=cells[i1],cells[i2]
            step=1 if hi>lo else -1
            pos=list(range(lo+step,hi+step,step))
            if all(I[r][c]==bg for r in pos for c in (cells[0:1]+cells[-1:])): pass
            # fill the straight segment between them with 2 where background
            for r in pos:
                c = (hi-lo)//abs(step)*... 
            break
    return O
# simpler manual version
def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=bg]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
    c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    O=[row[:] for row in I]
    top=[j for j in range(c0,c1+1) if I[r0][j]!=bg]
    bot=[j for j in range(c0,c1+1) if I[r1][j]!=bg]
    left=[i for i in range(r0,r1+1) if I[i][c0]!=bg]
    right=[i for i in range(r0,r1+1) if I[i][c1]!=bg]
    def seg(cells):
        for k in range(len(cells)-1):
            a,b=cells[k],cells[k+1]
            lo,hi=a,b
            while lo<hi:
                if O[lo][lo if False else 0]==bg: O[lo][a if False else b]=2
                lo+=1
            while lo>=hi:
                if O[lo][lo if False else 0]==bg: O[lo][a if False else b]=2
                lo-=1
    # horizontal fills along top/bottom rows: markers -> fill cols strictly between
    for cells in (top,bot):
        for k in range(len(cells)-1):
            a,b=cells[k],cells[k+1]
            for j in range(min(a,b)+1,max(a,b)):
                if O[r0 if cells is top else r1][j]==bg: O[r0 if cells is top else r1][j]=2
    # vertical fills along left/right cols
    for cells in (left,right):
        for k in range(len(cells)-1):
            a,b=cells[k],cells[k+1]
            for i in range(min(a,b)+1,max(a,b)):
                if O[i][c0 if cells is left else c1]==bg: O[i][c0 if cells is left else c1]=2
    return O
for i in range(1,6):
    print(i, f(G[f'Demo pair {i} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {i} output'])

from collections import Counter
def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=bg]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
    c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    O=[row[:] for row in I]
    def fill(cells, axis):
        for x,y in zip(cells,cells[1:]):
            lo,hi=min(x,y),max(x,y)
            for k in range(lo+1,hi):
                if axis=='h':
                    if O[r0 if False else r0][k]==bg: O[r0][k]=2
                else:
                    if O[k][c0 if False else c0]==bg: O[k][c0]=2
    # horizontal edges: top row r0, bottom row r1
    fill([j for j in range(c0,c1+1) if I[r0][j]!=bg],'h')
    fill([j for j in range(c0,c1+1) if I[r1][j]!=bg],'h')
    # vertical edges: left col c0, right col c1
    fill([i for i in range(r0,r1+1) if I[i][c0]!=bg],'v')
    fill([i for i in range(r0,r1+1) if I[i][c1]!=bg],'v')
    return O
for i in range(1,6):
    print(i, f(G[f'Demo pair {i} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {i} output'])
